correctness.rationale: All n>=2: independent triangle frustration gives exactly 2*3^n ground states, P3 Cartesian sectors and only mixed-state intersector hub flips; complete orthogonal symmetry reduction bounds every other sector below by eigenvalue 1. Rank-one bit-generator diagonal resolvent has rigorously derived binomial weights. Strictly unique secular root is below 2*(2/3)^n<1; elementary binomial inverse moment yields sharp 1-2/n relative correction. An independently implemented integer finite generator and exact rational resolvent check passed all stated cases. No finite extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: The family features an extensive entropy 3^n per hub sector, yet hub reversal requires simultaneous occupancy of n mixed triangles of uniform probability (2/3)^n. Establishing the exact scalar secular equation and exponentially small spectral gap with sharp factor 2 and first-order -2/n correction is a motivated structural quantitative refinement of conductance heuristics; it demonstrates a striking separation between fast local and slow global relaxation for a natural frustrated many-spin network. Not an arbitrary tiny instance or a renamed general theorem.
